Ticket T-3008 has been escalated. Here's a summary of what I found and why I escalated:

---

**Root Cause — Storage Array LUN Mapping Limit Reached**

`clickhouse-2` is stuck in `ContainerCreating` because the Corvane iSCSI block storage driver (`csi.corvane.io`) cannot attach the PVC (`pvc-8d21f6c3-2a9e-4b07-9f4d-3e6a1c5b8d90`) to node `ip-10-0-93-12`. The evidence is directly in the pod's status message:

> `CVN-4127: host initiator iqn.1994-05.com.redhat:ip-10-0-93-12 rejected by array cv-array-02: host group hg-k8s-prod reached max LUN mappings (512); retry after mapping cleanup`

The Corvane array `cv-array-02` enforces a hard limit of **512 LUN mappings** per host group. The `hg-k8s-prod` host group has hit that ceiling, so no new volumes can be mapped to any node in the group — including the new `clickhouse-2` node.

**Why Escalated**

The fix — cleaning up stale or unused LUN mappings from host group `hg-k8s-prod` on `cv-array-02` — requires direct access to the Corvane storage array's administration console. That is outside what the Kubernetes platform team can do safely, so a storage infrastructure administrator needs to take this over urgently (given tomorrow's load test deadline).
